Azata (Lillend).interest: Versatile support: bardic performances, healing and control spells, flight, and melee presence.
Azata (Lillend).usage: Start an inspiring performance when the party attacks. Save spells for decisive healing or control; use remaining healing before the summon expires.
Azata (Lillend).limits: Spells and performances consume actions. Short duration limits out-of-combat effects; check available spell slots on the creature sheet.

roles.support: Start an inspiring performance on the round the party attacks and keep healing spells for the ally who is about to drop.
roles.control: Against a dangerous foe, spend its turn on a control spell before engaging; its tail can then hold a weakened target.

Tiger (Dire).interest: Strong melee damage: pounce, bite and claws, then grab and rake.
Tiger (Dire).usage: Give it a clear charge lane toward a priority target. Pounce grants a full attack on the charge, while grab hampers the target afterward.
Tiger (Dire).limits: It needs room to charge. Its value falls against enemies that resist grab or are hard to hit. Celestial smite applies to evil targets.

roles.bruiser: Summon it within charge range of the priority target: pounce gives a full attack at once, and rake adds damage once it holds on.
roles.maneuvers: Use grab to pin a caster or archer in place; a grappled target can neither move nor cast freely.

Bear (Dire).interest: Durable melee control through claw attacks and grab.
Bear (Dire).usage: Use it to block an isolated enemy or protect the front line. Two claws give it two chances to start a grapple.
Bear (Dire).limits: A dire tiger has pounce and rake for a stronger charge. Check the target’s CMD before relying on grapple.

roles.maneuvers: Send it at an isolated foe: each claw can start a grapple, which takes that foe out of the fight while the party deals with the others.
roles.blocker: Place it in a corridor or in front of the casters; its hit points let it take several rounds of hits.

Azata (Bralani).interest: Mobile support with flight, ranged attacks, lightning bolt, wind wall, blur, and healing.
Azata (Bralani).usage: Use wind wall against archers, heal before the summon ends, or attack from the air. Lightning bolt can hit several aligned enemies.
Azata (Bralani).limits: Magic, ranged attacks, and melee compete for its actions. Check daily uses of abilities on its sheet.

roles.ranged: Keep it in the air and have it shoot with its bow at targets the melee cannot reach.
roles.area: When three or more foes stand in a line, open with lightning bolt before switching to the bow.
roles.support: Cast wind wall against enemy archers, and spend its healing on an ally before the summon ends.

Lion (Dire).interest: Melee cat with pounce, grab, and rake; useful when multiple lower-level summons are available.
Lion (Dire).usage: Charge a reachable target for an immediate full attack. Several lions can surround separate foes.
Lion (Dire).limits: It deals less damage than a single dire tiger. Size and obstacles may block a charge.

roles.bruiser: Summon it with a clear charge lane: pounce and rake make its first round its best one.
roles.maneuvers: Grab a lightly armored foe and keep it held while the party focuses elsewhere.

Archon (Hound).interest: Durable defender with aura of menace, magic circle against evil, and damage resistance.
Archon (Hound).usage: Keep it near allies to protect and enemies to engage. The circle supports the party while the aura hinders enemies.
Archon (Hound).limits: Summoned archons cannot teleport. Costly material components must be supplied for applicable powers.

roles.blocker: Put it between the enemies and the casters: its damage reduction, aura of menace and magic circle against evil make it a solid front line.
roles.bruiser: Against an evil foe, its greatsword and bite hit hard enough to finish a wounded target.

Bear (Grizzly).interest: Melee control with grab and enough hit points to hold an enemy.
Bear (Grizzly).usage: Engage an isolated physical target and use grapple to restrict its movement and actions.
Bear (Grizzly).limits: A claw must hit before grab; the maneuver then checks CMB against CMD. It offers little mobility or utility away from melee.

roles.maneuvers: Engage an isolated physical foe and grapple it to stop it moving or reaching the casters.
roles.blocker: Use its bulk and hit points to hold a doorway for a few rounds.

Lion.interest: A charge with pounce followed by bite, claws, grab, and rake.
Lion.usage: Summon near a vulnerable target with a clear charge lane. The immediate full attack is its main advantage.
Lion.limits: Its durability and attack bonuses trail higher-level choices. Obstacles that prevent a charge reduce its value.

roles.bruiser: Summon it near a vulnerable target with a clear charge lane: pounce gives an immediate full attack with grab and rake.

Wolf (Dire).interest: Trip after a bite, with a body large enough to occupy space.
Wolf (Dire).usage: Target an enemy with moderate CMD, ideally with allies ready to exploit the knockdown.
Wolf (Dire).limits: The single bite must hit first. High CMD makes trip unreliable, and its damage is modest.

roles.maneuvers: Bite the foe the fighters are about to hit: a successful trip leaves it prone, with -4 to AC against melee.
roles.bruiser: Its bite is strong for the level; flank with an ally to make every bite count.

Archon (Lantern).interest: Two ranged rays against touch AC that bypass damage reduction, plus flight, aid, and an aura of menace.
Archon (Lantern).usage: Stay at range against heavily armored or resistant enemies. Several archons can distribute rays and use aid to refresh allies’ temporary hit points.
Archon (Lantern).limits: The rays have limited range. Summoned creatures cannot teleport; continual flame needs a costly component.

roles.ranged: Keep it at range against heavily armored foes: its rays target touch AC and ignore damage reduction.
roles.support: Cast aid on the ally who will take the next hits; several lanterns can each refresh a different ally.

Cat (Leopard).interest: Small offensive cat with pounce, three attacks, grab, rake, and a climb speed.
Cat (Leopard).usage: Use a clear charge lane to reach a caster or lightly armored target.
Cat (Leopard).limits: Low hit points make it fragile. Without a charge or a target to grab, a lantern archon may be more reliable against high AC.

roles.bruiser: Charge a caster or lightly armored target: pounce gives three attacks with grab and rake on the first round.

Boar.interest: Ferocity lets it keep acting briefly below zero hit points.
Boar.usage: Use it as a temporary obstacle or to absorb another enemy attack; celestial smite can help against an evil target.
Boar.limits: One attack and low bonuses limit offense. Ferocity does not make up for a small hit point pool.

roles.blocker: Use it as a temporary obstacle: ferocity keeps it standing a little longer than its hit points suggest.
roles.bruiser: Its gore hits hard for level III; aim it at a wounded foe to finish it.

Wolf.interest: A bite with a trip attempt and scent, useful against a susceptible ground target.
Wolf.usage: Trip a nearby enemy to help melee allies; scent may reveal a hidden creature at close range.
Wolf.limits: The bite must hit first, and enemy CMD quickly becomes too high. Combat statistics are modest.

roles.maneuvers: Bite a nearby ground foe to trip it, so the melee allies attack a prone target.
roles.scout: Use scent to find a hidden or invisible creature close by.

Horse.interest: Large, fast creature for blocking space, a brief move, or a diversion.
Horse.usage: Use its size and speed immediately, such as to interpose it or cover a short distance.
Horse.limits: A duration measured in rounds limits travel. Its attacks are not specialized for combat.

roles.utility: Summon it to carry a wounded ally or cover distance quickly.
roles.blocker: Its large size fills a corridor; place it where it blocks an enemy's path.

Eagle.interest: Flight and multiple natural attacks for brief scouting or harassment.
Eagle.usage: Reach a nearby high position or threaten a fragile enemy.
Eagle.limits: It is fragile; spell duration limits scouting, and an animal may not understand complex instructions.

roles.scout: Send it over the battlefield or to a high point to see what waits ahead.

Dog.interest: Scent and ground presence for simple detection, guarding, or diversion.
Dog.usage: Follow a trail or briefly occupy an enemy rather than expecting significant damage.
Dog.limits: Low hit points and attack bonuses, short duration, and limited comprehension restrict its utility.

roles.scout: Use scent to follow a trail or to spot a hidden creature; do not expect real damage from it.

Achaierai.interest: Achaierai: abilities noted in the bestiary entry — trip.

roles.area: Release its black cloud when several foes stand close together; it damages everyone in the cloud.
roles.control: The cloud can leave foes confused; follow up while they act at random.

Aeon (Akhana).interest: Aeon (Akhana): abilities noted in the bestiary entry — grab, trip, fast healing, flight, spellcasting.

roles.maneuvers: Grab a dangerous foe and keep it held while its fast healing keeps it in the fight.
roles.control: Open with its spell-like abilities against a group before closing in.

Aeon (Paracletus).interest: Aeon (Paracletus): abilities noted in the bestiary entry — trip, flight, spellcasting.

roles.scout: Send it flying ahead to look around corners or over walls.
roles.utility: Use its spell-like abilities outside combat; it is too frail to fight.

Aeon (Theletos).interest: Aeon (Theletos): abilities noted in the bestiary entry — trip, fast healing, flight, spellcasting.

roles.control: Use its spell-like abilities on the strongest foe on the first round.
roles.support: Dispel a harmful effect on an ally or grant freedom of movement to a grappled one.

Agathion (Leonal).interest: Agathion (Leonal): abilities noted in the bestiary entry — pounce, grab, rake, poison, spellcasting.

roles.bruiser: Charge an evil foe: pounce, grab and rake make it one of the strongest melee summons of its level.
roles.area: Roar when several foes stand in front of it; the cone hits them all.
roles.support: Spend its healing on a dying ally before it engages.

Agathion (Silvanshee).interest: Agathion (Silvanshee): abilities noted in the bestiary entry — pounce, trip, flight, spellcasting.

roles.scout: Send it ahead: it is small, sees in the dark and can slip past guards.
roles.utility: Use its spell-like abilities to detect evil or carry a message, not to fight.

Agathion (Vulpinal).interest: Agathion (Vulpinal): abilities noted in the bestiary entry — pounce, invisibility, spellcasting.

roles.control: Use its song and spells to fascinate or slow foes before they reach the party.
roles.support: Keep it behind the front line and spend its healing on the ally who needs it most.

Alraune.interest: Alraune: abilities noted in the bestiary entry — grab, trip, constrict, spellcasting.

roles.maneuvers: Grab and constrict a foe that comes into reach; the vines hold it while it takes damage every round.
roles.control: Use its enchantment spells on the strongest foe before engaging.

Angel (Astral Deva).interest: Angel (Astral Deva): abilities noted in the bestiary entry — change shape, invisibility, fear, flight, spellcasting.

roles.bruiser: Engage the strongest melee foe: its disrupting mace can stun, which takes that foe out of the next round.
roles.support: Spend its healing and remove curse on allies before the summon ends.

Angel (Cassisian).interest: Angel (Cassisian): abilities noted in the bestiary entry — trip, breath weapon, change shape, flight, spellcasting.

roles.scout: Send it flying ahead; it is small and can change shape to go unnoticed.
roles.utility: Use its spell-like abilities and knowledge outside combat; its breath weapon is weak.

Angel (Monadic Deva).interest: Angel (Monadic Deva): abilities noted in the bestiary entry — invisibility, fear, flight, spellcasting.

roles.bruiser: Send it at an evil foe; its morningstar and smite deal strong damage for the level.
roles.support: Cast its healing and protective spells on allies before engaging.
roles.blocker: Its protective aura and high defenses let it hold the front line.

Angel (Movanic Deva).interest: Angel (Movanic Deva): abilities noted in the bestiary entry — invisibility, fear, flight, spellcasting.

roles.bruiser: Engage the strongest foe with its flaming greatsword.
roles.support: Its protective aura and healing help allies who stay close to it.

Animate Dream.interest: Animate Dream: abilities noted in the bestiary entry — fear, flight, spellcasting.

roles.control: Use its frightening and sleep effects against foes with weak Will saves.
roles.scout: Being incorporeal and flying, it can pass through walls to look ahead.

Ankou.interest: Ankou: abilities noted in the bestiary entry — flight, spellcasting.

roles.bruiser: Send it at a caster or archer; it strikes hard and its shadow doubles multiply its attacks.
roles.control: Use deeper darkness and its spell-like abilities to cut foes off from one another.

Ant (Giant).interest: Ant (Giant): abilities noted in the bestiary entry — grab, trip, poison, climb.

roles.maneuvers: Grab a foe with its bite and keep it held; several ants can each pin a different foe.

Ape (Dire).interest: Ape (Dire): abilities noted in the bestiary entry — climb.

roles.bruiser: Engage a foe in melee: two claws and a bite, plus rend when both claws hit.

Ape (Gorilla).interest: Ape (Gorilla): abilities noted in the bestiary entry — climb.

roles.bruiser: Send it into melee with a foe; it can also climb to reach archers on a wall or ledge.

Archon (Harbinger).interest: Archon (Harbinger): abilities noted in the bestiary entry — flight, spellcasting.

roles.support: Use its spell-like abilities to bless or protect allies at the start of the fight.
roles.scout: Send it flying ahead to warn the party.

Archon (Legion).interest: Archon (Legion): abilities noted in the bestiary entry — whirlwind, flight, spellcasting, ranged attacks.

roles.bruiser: Engage in melee where its several weapons hit the same foe.
roles.ranged: When the foe is out of reach, use its bow from the air.

Archon (Shield).interest: Archon (Shield): abilities noted in the bestiary entry — trip, flight, spellcasting.

roles.blocker: Put it in front of the most exposed ally; it is built to absorb attacks.
roles.support: Use its protective abilities on the ally under the heaviest attack.

Archon (Trumpet).interest: Archon (Trumpet): abilities noted in the bestiary entry — poison, invisibility, flight, spellcasting.

roles.control: Sound its trumpet when several foes are near: it can paralyze them.
roles.bruiser: Once foes are paralyzed, finish them with its greatsword.
roles.support: Spend its cleric spells on healing and protection before the summon ends.

Assassin Vine.interest: Assassin Vine: abilities noted in the bestiary entry — grab, trip, constrict.

roles.maneuvers: Summon it where foes will walk past: it grabs and constricts what comes into reach.
roles.control: Its entangle slows foes around it; use it to hold a passage.

Asura (Adhukait).interest: Asura (Adhukait): abilities noted in the bestiary entry — regeneration, spellcasting.

roles.bruiser: Engage in melee: its paired weapons hit many times per round, and regeneration keeps it fighting.

Asura (Aghasura).interest: Asura (Aghasura): abilities noted in the bestiary entry — grab, trip, poison, swallow whole, regeneration, swim, spellcasting.

roles.bruiser: Send it at a large foe: its many attacks and regeneration let it trade blows for several rounds.
roles.maneuvers: Grab and swallow a smaller foe to take it out of the fight.

Asura (Tripurasura).interest: Asura (Tripurasura): abilities noted in the bestiary entry — poison, fast healing, change shape, spellcasting.

roles.control: Use its spell-like abilities and poison on a single foe to weaken it.
roles.scout: It can change shape and slip past guards to look ahead.

Asura (Upasunda).interest: Asura (Upasunda): abilities noted in the bestiary entry — regeneration, invisibility, spellcasting.

roles.bruiser: Engage in melee: its many arms make a flurry of attacks against one foe.

Atomie.interest: Atomie: abilities noted in the bestiary entry — invisibility, flight, spellcasting.

roles.scout: Send it invisible and flying to look ahead.
roles.utility: Use its spell-like abilities outside combat; it is too frail to fight.

Avoral.interest: Avoral: abilities noted in the bestiary entry — invisibility, flight, spellcasting.

roles.area: Cast its area spells from the air when several foes are grouped.
roles.scout: Its keen eyes and fast flight make it a good lookout.

Axe Beak.interest: Axe Beak: abilities noted in the bestiary entry — melee combat.

roles.bruiser: Send it into melee with a ground foe; it hits hard for level III and moves fast.

Axiomite.interest: Axiomite: abilities noted in the bestiary entry — regeneration, flight, spellcasting.

roles.control: Use its spell-like abilities on the strongest foe first.
roles.support: Dispel harmful effects on allies, then hold its place near them.

Azata (Ghaele).interest: Azata (Ghaele): abilities noted in the bestiary entry — trip, gaze, light form, invisibility, flight, spellcasting, ranged attacks.

roles.ranged: Keep it at range and fire its light rays at foes the melee cannot reach.
roles.area: Cast its area spells when several foes are grouped.
roles.control: Its gaze can frighten evil foes; get close enough for it to work.

Azata (Lyrakien).interest: Azata (Lyrakien): abilities noted in the bestiary entry — flight, spellcasting.

roles.support: Keep it close to allies and spend its healing on the most wounded.
roles.scout: Send it flying ahead; it is tiny and easy to overlook.

Azer.interest: Azer: abilities noted in the bestiary entry — ranged attacks.

roles.bruiser: Send it into melee; its fire warhammer adds fire damage to each hit.

Badger.interest: Badger: abilities noted in the bestiary entry — trip, burrow.

roles.bruiser: Send it at a weak foe; rage makes it fight better than its size suggests.
roles.scout: It can burrow to come out behind a foe.

Badger (Dire).interest: Badger (Dire): abilities noted in the bestiary entry — trip, burrow.

roles.bruiser: Send it into melee; rage and ferocity keep it fighting.
roles.scout: It can burrow to come out behind the enemy line.

Baregara.interest: Baregara: abilities noted in the bestiary entry — grab, invisibility, climb, spellcasting.

roles.bruiser: Engage a foe in melee; it has many strong attacks.
roles.maneuvers: Grab a foe and hold it while the party focuses elsewhere.

Bat (Dire).interest: Bat (Dire): abilities noted in the bestiary entry — flight.

roles.scout: Its blindsense and flight let it find foes hidden in darkness.

Bebilith.interest: Bebilith: abilities noted in the bestiary entry — trip, web, climb, spellcasting.

roles.bruiser: Send it at a heavily armored foe: its bite rends armor.
roles.control: Throw its web on foes before engaging them.

Beetle (Fire).interest: Beetle (Fire): abilities noted in the bestiary entry — trip, flight.

roles.utility: Its glowing glands give light; use it as a lantern rather than a fighter.

Beetle (Giant Stag).interest: Beetle (Giant Stag): abilities noted in the bestiary entry — trip, trample, flight.

roles.bruiser: Trample through a line of foes, then bite the strongest.
roles.blocker: Its armor and size let it hold a passage.

Belker.interest: Belker: abilities noted in the bestiary entry — trip, smoke form, flight.

roles.bruiser: In smoke form, it enters a foe's lungs and deals damage each round.
roles.scout: Its smoke form and flight let it slip through narrow gaps.

Blink Dog.interest: Blink Dog: abilities noted in the bestiary entry — trip, scent, spellcasting.

roles.scout: It can teleport short distances to scout or get behind foes.
roles.maneuvers: Blink next to a foe and trip it with its bite.

Boar (Dire).interest: Boar (Dire): abilities noted in the bestiary entry — melee combat.

roles.bruiser: Its gore hits hard; send it at a wounded foe.
roles.blocker: Ferocity keeps it standing a little longer; use it to hold a line.

Bogeyman.interest: Bogeyman: abilities noted in the bestiary entry — invisibility, fear, spellcasting.

roles.control: Use its fear effects on foes with weak Will saves.
roles.scout: It can turn invisible to look ahead.

Brownie.interest: Brownie: abilities noted in the bestiary entry — spellcasting.

roles.utility: Use its minor spell-like abilities outside combat: repairs, light tricks, small errands.
roles.scout: It is tiny and can teleport a short way; send it to look ahead.

Bulette.interest: Bulette: abilities noted in the bestiary entry — trip, burrow.

roles.bruiser: Summon it near a cluster of foes: its leap lets it attack with all four claws at once.
roles.scout: It burrows and feels movement through the ground; use it to find foes under cover.

Cat (Cheetah).interest: Cat (Cheetah): abilities noted in the bestiary entry — trip.

roles.maneuvers: Sprint to a fleeing or distant foe and trip it with a bite.
roles.bruiser: Its speed lets it reach a caster at the back of the enemy line on the first round.

Centipede (Giant).interest: Centipede (Giant): abilities noted in the bestiary entry — trip, poison, climb.

roles.control: Bite a foe that relies on Dexterity; its poison lowers that score.

Cerberi.interest: Cerberi: abilities noted in the bestiary entry — trip.

roles.maneuvers: Its several heads give several trip attempts; target a foe with low CMD.
roles.bruiser: Flank with an ally: its many bites add up quickly.

Chaos Beast.interest: Chaos Beast: abilities noted in the bestiary entry — trip.

roles.control: Its touch can make a foe's body unstable; send it at a strong melee enemy.
roles.bruiser: It has several attacks; keep it engaged on one target.

Couatl.interest: Couatl: abilities noted in the bestiary entry — grab, trip, poison, constrict, invisibility, flight, spellcasting.

roles.control: Cast its spells first, then bite: its poison can put a foe to sleep.
roles.maneuvers: Grab and constrict a caster to stop its spells.

Crab (Giant).interest: Crab (Giant): abilities noted in the bestiary entry — grab, trip, constrict, swim.

roles.maneuvers: Grab and constrict a foe near the water or in a narrow place.
roles.blocker: Its shell gives it a good AC; place it in a passage to hold it.

Crocodile.interest: Crocodile: abilities noted in the bestiary entry — grab, trip, swim.

roles.maneuvers: Grab a foe and use its death roll to knock it prone, ideally near water.

Crocodile (Dire).interest: Crocodile (Dire): abilities noted in the bestiary entry — grab, trip, swallow whole, swim.

roles.maneuvers: Grab a foe, roll it to the ground, then swallow it if it is small enough.
roles.bruiser: Its bite is very strong; send it at the toughest ground foe.

Crysmal.interest: Crysmal: abilities noted in the bestiary entry — trip, burrow, spellcasting.

roles.scout: It burrows through stone and senses movement; use it to look past walls.
roles.area: Release its shard spray when several foes stand in front of it.

Cyclops.interest: Cyclops: abilities noted in the bestiary entry — ranged attacks.

roles.bruiser: Its great axe hits hard; send it at the toughest foe.
roles.ranged: Against a foe out of reach, use its heavy crossbow.

D'ziriak.interest: D'ziriak: abilities noted in the bestiary entry — grab, spellcasting.

roles.control: Use its spell-like abilities to blind or confuse foes.
roles.scout: It flies and moves well in shadows; send it to look ahead.

Daemon (Cacodaemon).interest: Daemon (Cacodaemon): abilities noted in the bestiary entry — fast healing, change shape, invisibility, flight, spellcasting.

roles.scout: Send it invisible and flying to look ahead.
roles.utility: Use its spell-like abilities outside combat; it is too weak to fight.

Daemon (Ceustodaemon).interest: Daemon (Ceustodaemon): abilities noted in the bestiary entry — breath weapon, invisibility, spellcasting.

roles.area: Breathe on several foes at once, then hold the line.
roles.blocker: It is a guardian by nature; place it in front of the casters.

Daemon (Derghodaemon).interest: Daemon (Derghodaemon): abilities noted in the bestiary entry — trip, invisibility, fear, spellcasting.

roles.bruiser: Engage the strongest foe: its many claws hit hard every round.
roles.control: Its fear and spell-like abilities can break a group of foes.

Daemon (Hydrodaemon).interest: Daemon (Hydrodaemon): abilities noted in the bestiary entry — grab, rake, flight, swim, spellcasting, ranged attacks.

roles.control: Spit on a dangerous foe: the spittle can put it to sleep.
roles.ranged: Keep it at range, near water if possible, and spit each round.

Daemon (Leukodaemon).interest: Daemon (Leukodaemon): abilities noted in the bestiary entry — flight, spellcasting, ranged attacks.

roles.ranged: Keep it at range: its arrows carry disease.
roles.control: Use its spell-like abilities to weaken a group before shooting.

Daemon (Meladaemon).interest: Daemon (Meladaemon): abilities noted in the bestiary entry — invisibility, fear, flight, spellcasting.

roles.control: Its fear and hunger effects weaken foes; use them first.
roles.bruiser: Then engage a weakened foe in melee.

Daemon (Piscodaemon).interest: Daemon (Piscodaemon): abilities noted in the bestiary entry — grab, poison, constrict, invisibility, swim, spellcasting.

roles.maneuvers: Grab a foe with its claws and constrict it while its poison works.
roles.bruiser: Its many attacks and poison make it strong against a single target.

Daemon (Thanadaemon).interest: Daemon (Thanadaemon): abilities noted in the bestiary entry — gaze, fear, spellcasting.

roles.control: Use its gaze and fear on foes with weak Will saves, then its death spells on the strongest.

Daemon (Vulnudaemon).interest: Daemon (Vulnudaemon): abilities noted in the bestiary entry — invisibility, spellcasting.

roles.bruiser: Send it into melee against a single foe.
roles.scout: It can turn invisible to look ahead.

Demodand (Tarry).interest: Demodand (Tarry): abilities noted in the bestiary entry — flight, spellcasting.

roles.control: Its sticky tar hinders foes; use its spell-like abilities to cut them off.
roles.bruiser: Then engage a hindered foe in melee.

Demon (Babau).interest: Demon (Babau): abilities noted in the bestiary entry — invisibility, spellcasting.

roles.bruiser: Flank a foe with an ally: its sneak attack makes each hit count, and its slime damages weapons that strike it.

Demon (Coloxus).interest: Demon (Coloxus): abilities noted in the bestiary entry — invisibility, flight, spellcasting.

roles.control: Use its spell-like abilities on foes with weak Will saves before engaging.

Demon (Dretch).interest: Demon (Dretch): abilities noted in the bestiary entry — fear, spellcasting.

roles.control: Release its stinking cloud on a group of foes on the first round.
roles.blocker: Several dretches can fill a passage; they are expendable.

Demon (Glabrezu).interest: Demon (Glabrezu): abilities noted in the bestiary entry — spellcasting.

roles.bruiser: Its pincers hit hard; send it at the toughest foe.
roles.control: Use its confusion and other spell-like abilities on a group first.

Demon (Hezrou).interest: Demon (Hezrou): abilities noted in the bestiary entry — grab, swim, spellcasting.

roles.control: Bring it next to several foes: its stench can sicken or nauseate them.
roles.maneuvers: Grab a nauseated foe and hold it.

Demon (Incubus).interest: Demon (Incubus): abilities noted in the bestiary entry — change shape, flight, spellcasting.

roles.control: Use its charm and suggestion on foes with weak Will saves.
roles.scout: It can change shape to mingle with foes and gather information.

Demon (Kalavakus).interest: Demon (Kalavakus): abilities noted in the bestiary entry — trip, spellcasting.

roles.bruiser: Charge a foe: its horns and spines hit hard.
roles.maneuvers: Knock a foe prone to set up the party's attacks.

Demon (Nalfeshnee).interest: Demon (Nalfeshnee): abilities noted in the bestiary entry — flight, spellcasting.

roles.area: Use its unholy nimbus and area spell-like abilities on a group of foes.
roles.control: The nimbus can daze foes; follow up while they cannot act.

Demon (Omox).interest: Demon (Omox): abilities noted in the bestiary entry — grab, trip, poison, swim, climb, spellcasting, ranged attacks.

roles.maneuvers: Engulf or grab a foe and hold it in its slime.
roles.ranged: Spit its slime at a foe out of reach.

Demon (Schir).interest: Demon (Schir): abilities noted in the bestiary entry — invisibility, spellcasting.

roles.bruiser: Charge a foe: it hits hard for its level.

Demon (Shadow).interest: Demon (Shadow): abilities noted in the bestiary entry — pounce, fear, flight, spellcasting.

roles.bruiser: Pounce on a foe from the shadows; its incorporeal claws ignore armor.
roles.control: Use its fear and darkness to split foes.
roles.scout: Incorporeal and flying, it passes through walls to look ahead.

Demon (Succubus).interest: Demon (Succubus): abilities noted in the bestiary entry — change shape, flight, spellcasting.

Wasp (Giant).interest: Wasp (Giant): abilities noted in the bestiary entry — poison, flight.

roles.control: Its sting poisons Dexterity; target a foe who relies on it.
roles.scout: It flies; send it to look ahead.

Weasel (Dire).interest: Weasel (Dire): abilities noted in the bestiary entry — grab, trip.

roles.maneuvers: Grab a foe and drain its blood.

Weasel (Giant).interest: Weasel (Giant): abilities noted in the bestiary entry — grab, trip.

roles.maneuvers: Grab a foe and hold it.

Weedwhip.interest: Weedwhip: abilities noted in the bestiary entry — trip, poison.

roles.control: Its poison hinders foes who come near it.

Whale.interest: Whale: abilities noted in the bestiary entry — trip, swim.

roles.bruiser: In water, its slam hits very hard.

Whale (Great White).interest: Whale (Great White): abilities noted in the bestiary entry — trip, swim.

roles.bruiser: In water, it hits very hard and can smash a ship.
roles.blocker: Its huge hit points let it take many hits.

Wolverine.interest: Wolverine: abilities noted in the bestiary entry — trip, burrow, climb.

roles.bruiser: Its rage makes it fight hard; send it at a lone foe.

Xill.interest: Xill: abilities noted in the bestiary entry — grab, paralysis, ranged attacks.

roles.control: Its bite paralyzes; strike the most dangerous foe.
roles.maneuvers: Grab a paralyzed foe and hold it.

Yeth Hound.interest: Yeth Hound: abilities noted in the bestiary entry — trip, flight.

roles.control: Its bay frightens foes; bring it near them.

Damned petitioner.interest: Damned petitioner: petitioner summoned through Summon Evil Monster; its abilities depend on the exact profile available in the loaded sources.

roles.blocker: Use it as an expendable body to fill a gap or take a blow.

Hunted petitioner.interest: Hunted petitioner: petitioner summoned through Summon Evil Monster; its abilities depend on the exact profile available in the loaded sources.

roles.blocker: Use it as an expendable body to fill a gap or take a blow.

Larvae petitioner.interest: Larvae petitioner: petitioner summoned through Summon Evil Monster; its abilities depend on the exact profile available in the loaded sources.

roles.blocker: Use it as an expendable body to fill a gap or take a blow.

Glyptodon (megafauna).interest: Glyptodon: large land megafauna useful mainly for blocking space and absorbing melee attacks.

roles.blocker: Its shell makes it a wall; place it in front of the casters.

Ramidreju.interest: Ramidreju: fast burrowing and climbing beast whose bite grabs its prey.

roles.maneuvers: Bite a lightly armored caster or archer: its grab keeps the target from acting freely.
roles.scout: Its speed, climb and burrow let it reach a flank or a hidden foe first.

Liminal Sprite.interest: Liminal Sprite: tiny flying fey with spell-like abilities and a distracting repartee.

roles.control: Spend its spell-like abilities on the most dangerous foe before it acts.
roles.scout: Fly it ahead, out of reach, to see what waits beyond a door or a corner.

Archon (Stag).interest: Archon (Stag): forest archon whose gore pushes foes away, with a bow, an aura of menace and spell-like abilities.

roles.blocker: Gore a foe that reaches the casters: the push sends it 10 ft. back.
roles.ranged: Against a flyer or a distant foe, use its longbow.

Owl (Giant).interest: Owl (Giant): silent flyer with keen senses and sharp talons.

roles.scout: Send it flying silently ahead at night; its senses spot foes the party cannot see.
roles.bruiser: Dive on an isolated foe with its talons, then fly away from melee.

Dragonne.interest: Dragonne: winged brass-scaled lion that pounces and roars to fatigue its foes.

roles.bruiser: Pounce on a foe at the start of the fight: a full attack on the charge.
roles.area: Roar when several foes are near: those who fail their save are fatigued.

Erinyes (Repentant).interest: Erinyes (Repentant): redeemed fallen angel, a flying archer with an entangling rope and spell-like abilities.

roles.ranged: Keep it flying out of reach and let its bow shoot the most exposed foe every round.
roles.control: Throw its rope on a fleeing or dangerous foe to entangle it.

Agathion (Avoral).interest: Agathion (Avoral): bird-winged agathion with claws, a fear aura, lightning bolts, hold person and lay on hands.

roles.area: Open with its lightning bolt on foes standing in a line.
roles.control: Cast hold person on a humanoid foe, then let the party finish it.
roles.support: Spend its lay on hands on a dying ally before the summon ends.

Moon Dog.interest: Moon Dog: celestial hound whose bite trips, whose bay frightens foes, and who can cloud itself with mirror images.

roles.maneuvers: Bite a foe to trip it, so the party's melee fighters attack it prone.
roles.area: Bay when several foes are near.

Angel (Balisse).interest: Angel (Balisse): angel of confession with a flaming mace, a protective aura, holy smite, hold person and healing.

roles.area: Cast holy smite on a group of evil foes.
roles.control: Cast hold person on the most dangerous humanoid foe.
roles.support: Keep allies within its protective aura and spend its cure serious wounds on a falling ally.

Udaeus (Celestial Squire).interest: Udaeus (Celestial Squire): armored winged warrior with a holy weapon, frightful presence, fast healing and positive energy.

roles.bruiser: Charge an evil foe: its holy weapon adds damage, and more against dragons.
roles.blocker: Fast healing and its shield keep it standing; place it between the foes and the casters.
roles.support: Channel positive energy when several allies are wounded.

Archon (Exscinder).interest: Archon (Exscinder): archon of judgment whose flaming longsword dispels magic on each hit, with true seeing and an aura of menace.

roles.bruiser: Engage a foe protected by spells: each hit can dispel them.
roles.control: Strike enemy casters first: its censoring strike strips their magic.

Azata (Raelis).interest: Azata (Raelis): shapechanging azata whose slams stun, casting sorcerer spells including symbols of fear, pain and sleep.

roles.bruiser: Slam the strongest foe: a stunned foe loses its turn.
roles.area: Place a symbol where foes will pass before melee.

Lion (Grisantian).interest: Lion (Grisantian): huge lion with a deadly pounce and rake, whose roar breaks foes' nerve.

roles.bruiser: Pounce on the strongest foe: pounce and rake make it one of the hardest hitters of its level.
roles.blocker: Its size and reach hold a corridor or a doorway.

Phoenix.interest: Phoenix: fiery bird of rebirth with a flaming aura, fire spells, healing and self-resurrection.

roles.area: Fly over the foes: its shroud of flame and fire spells burn all those near it.
roles.support: Spend its healing on allies in danger before the summon ends.
roles.bruiser: Against a fire-resistant foe, attack with its talons and beak rather than its flames.
